summary.one_liner: InfluxDB 3 Core is an open source time series database for real-time event, analytics, and monitoring data, built on Apache Arrow, DataFusion, and Parquet.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes InfluxDB 3 Core as a database for collecting, processing, transforming, and storing event and time series data, aimed at real-time ingest and fast query responses for dashboards, monitoring, and automation. It stores data as Apache Parquet on object storage (S3, Azure, GCP) or on local disk. It accepts line protocol writes and is compatible with the InfluxDB 1.x and 2.x write APIs. Queries can be run with SQL, InfluxQL, or Flight SQL through an HTTP API on port 8181. It includes an embedded Python VM for plugins and triggers. The README states last-value queries return under 10ms and distinct metadata queries under 30ms.
use_cases: Real-time dashboards and interactive user interfaces
how_to_run: Docker images, Debian packages, RPM packages, and tarballs are available on the InfluxData downloads page
See the getting started guide for InfluxDB 3 Core
stack: Python (embedded VM for plugins and triggers)
notable: Diskless architecture with object storage support, or local disk with no dependencies
Compatible with InfluxDB 1.x and 2.x write APIs and the 1.x InfluxQL query API
Supports SQL, InfluxQL, and Flight SQL query languages
Embedded Python VM for plugins and triggers
Separate branches for v2.x (main-2.x) and v1.x (master-1.x)
caveats: The README does not give install commands beyond pointing to downloads and guides
Other InfluxDB versions live on separate branches, so this branch covers only v3 Core
Enterprise edition is mentioned separately; the README does not describe its licensing terms
